description: Check every recorded verdict against the files as they are now. Reports verdicts about files that changed since, agent instructions that changed since, and (with coverageBase) changed files no verdict covers. Read-only.

coverageBase.description: Branch to compare with, for example origin/main. Every file changed since it then needs a current, passing verdict.

require.description: Files that must have a current, passing verdict.

name: slipmark_verify
title: Check verdicts with Slipmark
